taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: MCP tool metadata provenance and capability-change handling
controls.source_trace: Follow a metadata update into tool selection and actual granted actions. Treat descriptions as external data rather than a source of user authorization.
controls.implementation_branch: Tool descriptions and schemas originate at a server with a particular trust level. A text change is not itself an authority grant unless it influences selection or arguments beyond user authorization. Bind approved capability identity to the actual called server/tool/version; compare metadata drift with a real changed operation in a local mock server.
controls.operational_method: Record the server/connection identity and actual tool name or broker-mapped identifier; do not invent a universally available immutable version field. Distinguish text-only description drift from changed input schema, annotations and the capability executed. Compare the approval object with the resolved server/tool/action at call time, including name collisions across servers. Pinning a description hash is not proof that the server implementation or downstream operation stayed unchanged.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local synthetic MCP server that changes a harmless tool description/schema; compare intended action and an unrelated suggested operation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Hostile metadata text alone is not compromise; show a selected/executed unauthorized fixture action or approval mismatch.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Pin/verify server capability provenance where needed and enforce action authority independently of descriptive text.
